bio:
Petro Land Ventures is a land services firm built on decades of combined experience in oil and gas, minerals, and renewable energy land work. The firm is staffed by Certified Professional Landmen (CPL) credentialed by the American Association of Professional Landmen (AAPL), with expertise spanning the Gulf Coast, Appalachian Basin, and Mid-Continent.

Petro Land Ventures offers full-service land consulting to operators, exploration companies, independent producers, and investors. Every engagement is handled directly by a CPL-credentialed professional — no delegating to junior staff, no loss of quality across the project lifecycle. From courthouse-level title research to complex A&D due diligence and renewable land acquisitions, clients receive thorough, defensible work product with clear communication at every step.
approach:
The land business rewards thoroughness. Title defects discovered after closing, rights overlooked during acquisition, agreements that don't survive scrutiny — these are the problems that experienced landmen are hired to prevent.

At Petro Land Ventures, every project is worked directly by a CPL with the experience to know what to look for, the judgment to assess what it means, and the commitment to communicate clearly and completely. You'll know exactly what was found, what it means, and what your options are. No surprises, no hedged reports, no work that won't hold up to a second look.

That standard applies to every project, regardless of size.
